sol.meta: 2026-08 to present · 2,000+ commits · in live use company-wide
sol.desc: Doctor content production system for SOL Integrative Wellness Centre: one sentence writes a full month of scripts → doctors film on a phone teleprompter → automatic rough cut → review → scheduled social publishing → one-click KPI reports. Used daily by non-technical staff across the company, with a Chinese / English / Malay interface.
sol.open: Open the SOL Studio landing page
features: Create Script: type “Dr Vig November” and AI writes the whole month in the doctor’s own voice, with hooks and medical-claims checks; also parses Marketing’s monthly PPT plans
Mobile filming app (iOS / Android, Expo): shot cards + scrolling teleprompter, with automatic upload and filing to the shared drive
AI auto rough cut: removes pauses and retakes, Whisper-aligned captions, B-roll matching, animated key figures, 3-second hooks, covers
Pass to AI: edit a video with one sentence; jobs queue to AI helpers on each Mac; exports CapCut project files
Browser timeline editor: multitrack, color grading, voice separation, background removal, transitions, 16 caption styles, and AI-cut to watch AI edit step by step
Multicam podcasts: cameras and mics auto-synced by audio, with automatic switching to whoever is speaking
Design board: AI writes FB / IG post copy; Auto Design produces three layered, editable PSD versions at once
Doctor AI voiceover: in-house cloned voices for narration; phone numbers read digit by digit, mixed English/Malay read as written
GHL scheduled publishing: FB / IG / TikTok / YouTube, with comment monitoring that alerts on new replies
Library of 3,000+ finished videos, dashboard, Content KPI Excel reports, webinars and client lists
Permissions and privacy: role/department access, chat tied to member identity, patient consent forms visible only to authorised staff
MCP server: Claude and other external AIs can create tasks, write scripts and read timelines directly in the app
sol.caption: The public SOL Studio landing page (the working system sits behind login). It grew out of AI-Content-studio (Aug 2026, MVP: web scripting → phone teleprompter filming → automatic post-production).
sol.summary: A content production system for doctors: one sentence writes the script → shoot with a phone teleprompter → AI rough cut → scheduled publishing → KPIs. Used across the company every day.

onset.meta: Started 2026-11-10 · 455 commits in 10 days · Mac and iPhone / iPad apps running on my own devices · not yet publicly released
onset.desc: A creator studio rewritten from scratch: scripting, shooting, editing, covers and posts, and AI generation in one app. One codebase ships as a Mac app and an iPhone / iPad app that sync offline-first. AI Onset sits on every screen: it sees the screen, searches the web, talks by voice and can operate every feature in the app, step by step in front of you, with stop and whole-run undo.
features: Mac app and iPhone / iPad app (Tauri 2 + Swift): one codebase, three shells; on the phone, AVFoundation for export, Apple Speech for dictation, Apple Vision for background removal, Image Playground for image generation

Sync and relay: pair by scanning a QR code; offline-first, and if both sides edit, both versions are kept; away from home on 4G / 5G, an end-to-end encrypted connection to the Mac at home runs through a Cloudflare Worker + Durable Objects

AI Onset: an AI assistant on every page that sees the screen and cursor, searches the web and talks by voice; all features sit in one action catalogue, and 1–10 agents can share the work, each a colored cursor that flies to the spot it is editing
One-click MCP install: external AIs such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT / Codex and Cursor can operate Onset directly, with every step shown on screen

Create Script: the AI writes in six visible steps: angle, Hook, first draft in your style, platform check, de-AI the wording into natural speech, risk check (medical claims, plagiarism); 9 formats, 36 styles
Recording: a teleprompter that follows your voice (5 languages), voice commands, Bluetooth remote keys, countdown; the iPhone can serve as the Mac's camera or a remote camera for multi-cam

CapCut-style editor: keyframes, 39 transitions, masks, LUT and HLG / Log → 709, speed curves, 20 subtitle styles plus karaoke, dozens of kinetic-text styles, Three.js / Godot cards, built-in royalty-free music and sound effects
Auto-cut and AI Edit: listens to the whole video before cutting, finds retakes automatically, edits chapter by chapter, chapter cards, emphasis zooms; long videos are split into multiple Shorts

Multi-hour multi-cam podcasts: reads straight from an external drive without copying, aligns by sound, detects the speaker to switch cameras automatically, exports at consistent loudness (−14 / −16 LUFS)

Make it without shooting: a script alone can become a video, with visuals for every line: the AI researches and finds freely licensed footage, fills gaps with AI images or animated cards; it estimates total time up front and shows time remaining while it works
Kinetic-type shots: one big word per beat, camera moves, transitions, 3D props, fake app screens; exportable to EffectCraft
Animation board: the AI plans first, then draws real illustrations and rigs them to move; frame-by-frame animation, repeating patterns, 3D text, and you can take over and edit by hand
AI generation: local (MiniMax H3 video, Qwen Image, my own LoRA) plus cloud Higgsfield and Theater; Theater quotes a price first and starts only after you agree
Covers, posts and Branding styles: 35 layouts, curved text, carousels; a channel's own intro and outro, name bars, chapter cards and watermark; the iPhone can design on its own without the Mac
Style packs and skins: one pack carries subtitles, layouts, fonts and music, and can even swap the app's name, icon and colors (Ed25519-signed); projects are packaged as .onsetpack to share

Accounts and licensing: a Cloudflare Worker + D1 account service with sign-up, approval and per-device licensing; the interface is available in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Malay, Japanese and Korean
Export: MP4 / MOV / MP3 / WAV, plus CapCut, FCPXML, Premiere XML and FilmCraft project files
onset.cap_editing: Editing: Auto-cut hears the whole clip once and makes the captions at the same time (demo clip).
onset.cap_start: Mac Start screen: six entry points, AI Onset in the corner.
onset.cap_script: Create Script: AI Onset writing for real, with each step and the risk check listed on the left.
onset.cap_recording: Recording: the teleprompter over the camera picture, able to follow your voice.
onset.cap_phone: iPhone app: simple editor, post design, Start, the generation library synced with the Mac, prompt steps for other AI platforms.
onset.summary: A personal studio for creators: scripting, shooting, editing, design and AI generation in one app, on Mac, iPhone and iPad.

points.d: Mac, iPhone and iPad sync offline; on the go, you can still reach your Mac at home.
On every page. It sees the screen, searches the web, takes voice, and works step by step in front of you, and you can stop it anytime.
AI scriptwriting, teleprompter shooting, CapCut-style editing, Auto-cut, automatic subtitles.
AI finds free stock footage, local and cloud generation, kinetic text, Animation board.
35 layouts; the iPhone can design on its own without the Mac.
Take subtitles, layouts, fonts and music with you in one pack; the interface comes in 6 languages.

onset.cap_board: Animation board: a character split into layers (head, arms, legs, tie…), each with its own timeline and keyframes; AI Onset on the left, with an outside AI working through MCP.

vpipe.desc: A small web app that runs MiniMax H3 (video with sound) and Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo (images) locally on a Mac — no cloud, no credits. Built-in setup checks and one-click model download, AI prompt enhancement, character LoRAs, queueing and 2× upscaling; offloads work to the Neural Engine, cutting a 5-second video on an M3 Air from ~73 to ~35 minutes.
vpipe.summary: A small web app that runs AI video and image generation locally on a Mac. Open source (MIT), no cloud, no credits.

stock.desc: US and Malaysian (Bursa Malaysia) stock research dashboard: market overview, candlestick charts and news per stock, holding signals with plain-language notes, backtesting, a paper-trading account, and daily Traditional Chinese briefings written by four AI assistants. Python + Streamlit, runs locally only.
stock.summary: A US and Malaysian stock research dashboard where an AI assistant writes a daily briefing. Personal use, runs only on my own machine.
